then.text: I'm still putting this sign up. It won't hammer itself.
Please do not roam while I'm working. It makes the paperwork wobble.

else.text: Halt! This stretch of moorland is now the property of the Enclosure.
It's the A537. It's a road.
Was the A537. Lord Vane has bought the view. And the heather. And the fog.
I'm putting up a sign. It says PRIVATE: NO ROAMING in a very firm font.

then.text: I'm roaming. Look. I'm roaming right now.
You can't. The sign isn't even up yet! Wait, that's worse for me.

else.text: The fog is a Heritage Feature, and we don't discuss its terms.
Lord Vane says it adds atmosphere. It adds about nine bruises a week.
Right. Carry on, then. But I'll be noting it down. In triplicate.
